newsitem.title: ESTONIA: SHARE TRADE LOWER BUT PRICES GAIN.
newsitem.headline: SHARE TRADE LOWER BUT PRICES GAIN.

text.p: * Total trade on the Estonian bourse was 41.2 million
kroons versus more than 60 million kroons yesterday.
* Talse gained 0.49 percent to close on 248.83.
* Forekspank was the most active stock and turned
over 6.4 million kroons to gain by 1.65 to 184.10 kroons.
* Market capitalisation increased slightly to 13.6 billion
kroons from 13.5 billion kroons on Thursday.
